author: UatuCC
quote:
I have never left a review for any game in my 30 years of gaming. But this game is so bad it left me no choice. I completed the game but GTA VI = Cracked out SIMs 4 Chore DLC with better graphics. 

Story? Bad. 

Characters? Terrible. 

Freedom of choice? Non existant. 

There is nothing about this game that plays like a real GTA title. Nothing.

Anyone giving this above a 5 at best, is either paid, a bot, or brain dead.
